title: Cumberland Steam Plant
extract: Cumberland Steam Plant is an operating power station of at least 2600-megawatts (MW) in Cumberland City, Stewart, Tennessee, United States with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating. It is also known as Cumberland Fossil Plant, Cumberland Combined Cycle Plant.
